affected_boundaries: authenticated worker delivery to coordinator action result

observed_behavior: A verified delivery was READY_TO_MERGE after checkout loss, but the original rebase action result failed because the checkout was absent.
expected_behavior: The exact authenticated delivery and requested Git ancestry suffice for both scheduler readiness and recording the original action result when fresh complete host and branch-tip proof survive.
causal_mechanism: The action-result validator required a physical checkout while scheduler reconciliation independently accepted durable delivery proof after checkout loss.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Two transitions of one lifecycle used inconsistent definitions of verified worker completion.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The earlier transition advertises a safe integration path that the later transition cannot complete when the ephemeral checkout disappears.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: A missing-checkout delivery is usable only when its authenticated assignment, fresh complete idle host observation, exact branch tip, and requested integration ancestry all agree.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Use one missing-delivery proof for scheduler observation and rebase-result validation, with the action-specific ancestry check at result recording.

applicability_conditions: A worker recorded an authenticated delivery and its original managed checkout later disappeared.
The coordinator retains the original REQUEST_REBASE action for that assignment.
known_non_matches: A changed branch tip or stale host observation cannot establish the delivered revision.
A worker with no authenticated delivery still requires its original checkout recovery.
confirmation_evidence: The original focused test failed at the same CAMPAIGN_WORKER_BINDING_MISSING gate after checkout removal.
The corrected test passes with an exact branch tip and fresh host observation while retaining the negative cases.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: waiting worker delivery remains integrable before and after its checkout disappears
